purpose: Structured demonstrations of sufficient recognition and exact verification; no claim about general g(n).

mixed_omega_then_hall.description: 35 cubic monomials on {11,13,17,19,23}, plus the two displayed exceptional sources.

certificate.claim: For every stated shift there exists a subset of at most 2*n distinct targets whose product is divisible by the source product.
certificate.method: Exact sufficient rules at fixed ambient M; deterministic peeling, no interval or CRT search.
limitations: This is recognition, not a constructed interval cover.
UNKNOWN is not a mathematical obstruction or counterexample.
Unrestricted exact and asymptotic Erdos 708 remain unresolved by this work.
Proofs have internal AI-assisted audits, not formal verification or external referee approval; no priority claim.

verification.conclusion: Exact 2*n existence bound certified for every x>=0.
